vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: tickerdb
Version: 0.1.2

The tickerdb skill bundle provides a comprehensive integration for the TickerDB market intelligence API. It includes well-defined instructions for the AI agent to handle user onboarding (email/OTP authentication), data retrieval (summaries, historical snapshots, and categorical searches), and automation via OpenClaw's cron system. The skill follows standard security practices for API interactions, such as using environment variables for keys and verifying webhook signatures, and contains no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and runtime instructions are coherent with its stated purpose: it only needs a TICKERDB API key and the SKILL.md describes API calls and an onboarding flow that match a typical API-backed data integration.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (market intelligence for assets) align with the single required secret (TICKERDB_KEY) and the listed API endpoints. No unrelated credentials, binaries, or install artifacts are requested.

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions include an onboarding flow that asks the user for an email and 6-digit verification code and then calls the TickerDB auth endpoints to obtain an apiKey. This is appropriate for account setup, but it does involve the agent handling user-supplied email and one-time codes (and displaying the resulting apiKey). The instructions do not ask the agent to read arbitrary local files or other system secrets.

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent with its purpose. Before installing: (1) know that it will ask you for an email and a 6‑digit verification code to create or sign into your TickerDB account and will show/persist the returned apiKey if you agree — only confirm persistence if you trust the platform to store secrets securely; (2) the only required secret is TICKERDB_KEY, so avoid supplying broader credentials; (3) review TickerDB's dashboard and key permissions (use a limited/read-only key if available); (4) confirm whether the agent will set up the 'daily report' and 'webhook' behaviors and what webhook URLs or delivery mechanisms it will ask you to provide; and (5) do not paste your API key publicly. If you want extra assurance, inspect the full SKILL.md (on your platform) to see any additional endpoints or webhook setup steps not included in the truncated excerpt.
